scientific_purpose: Fallback sampling rate when Sampling Frequency column is missing or non-positive
formula: fs = 250.0 if Sampling Frequency missing or <= 0
parameter_origin: IonOptix CytoCypher standard acquisition rate
validation_status: Audit: silent fallback masks missing metadata
change_justification: Record declared_fs and fs_provenance in sheet metadata; warn/flag when Sampling Frequency is missing rather than silently assuming 250 Hz.

scientific_purpose: Reconcile declared Sampling Frequency against row Begin/End timestamps
formula: if len(implied_fs_list)>=2 and std<0.5 and |med_implied - fs|>1.0: fs = round(med_implied) if |med_implied-round|<0.05 else med_implied
parameter_origin: Empirical timestamp-grid consistency check
known_dataset_references: NICONICO / DISH1TEST exported workbooks with 208.32 Hz header vs 250 Hz timestamps
validation_status: Validated by synthetic and file-format tests
change_justification: Store declared_fs, implied_fs, and fs_reconciled flag in DataFrame attrs / metadata so reconciliation is transparent and auditable.

scientific_purpose: Robust high-frequency white-noise SD estimator from first differences
formula: sigma = MAD(diff(x), scale='normal') / sqrt(2)
parameter_origin: Gaussian first-difference variance identity Var(dx)=2*sigma^2
validation_status: Mathematically exact for additive white Gaussian noise
change_justification: Retain mathematical identity.

scientific_purpose: Classify overlapping row samples as identical vs contradictory during timestamp stitching
formula: |y_new - y_existing| <= max(1e-5, 1e-4 * scale); half-integer sample tie-break to grid parity
parameter_origin: Floating-point serialization precision of IonOptix Excel export
validation_status: Validated by row-partition and overlap unit tests
change_justification: Retain exact timestamp alignment and permanent NaN masking of contradictory samples.

scientific_purpose: Estimate high-frequency noise SD of PixelCorrelation signal
formula: sigma = 1.4826 * median(|dx - median(dx)|) / sqrt(2)
parameter_origin: Standard normal MAD and first-difference identity
validation_status: Verified mathematical identity
change_justification: Retain unchanged.

scientific_purpose: Determine PixelCorrelation polarity from excitation-contraction coupling (ECC) latency after calcium upstroke
formula: Match calcium peaks to mechanical extrema in [-0.03s, min(0.42s, 0.72*IBI)] and onset slope in [0, 0.12s]
parameter_origin: Cardiomyocyte ECC physiology (Ca2+ transient precedes mechanical shortening)
validation_status: Physiologically grounded and validated on synthetic + experimental traces
change_justification: Retain when explicitly enabled in pixel-calcium mode; document ECC latency window.

scientific_purpose: Compute antisymmetric cycle duration asymmetry (contraction vs relaxation) and peak-vs-rest variance ratio
formula: dur_ratio = (t_fall - t_rise)/(t_fall + t_rise); var_ratio = (iqr_bot - iqr_top)/(iqr_bot + iqr_top)
parameter_origin: Signal morphology & antisymmetry under sign inversion
validation_status: Verified antisymmetric and scale/shift invariant
change_justification: Retain antisymmetric morphological feature extraction.

scientific_purpose: Rule 2: Override opposite dwell score when onset kinetics and curvature agree in 1.5-2.4 Hz band
formula: if 1.5 <= freq <= 2.4 and |onset_score|>=0.20 and |curv_score|>=0.15 and |dwell_score|<=0.48
parameter_origin: Tuned specifically to 2 Hz IMR90 segments (comment cites Seg 25)
validation_status: Confirmed frequency-band and segment-tuned heuristic
change_justification: Replace discrete 1.5-2.4 Hz gate with continuous duty-cycle / cycle-period weighting of dwell vs kinetic/curvature cues.

scientific_purpose: Rules 4A-4E: Five cascading special branches for high-frequency (tc <= 0.40s / >= 2.5 Hz) polarity resolution
formula: if tc <= 0.40: check 4A (dwell+onset+curv), 4B (cycle_dur+var), 4C (dwell+cycle_var), 4D (cycle_dur+curv), 4E (cycle_dur+var+onset)
validation_status: Confirmed overfitting via cascading sub-branches
change_justification: Unify into a single continuous, antisymmetric composite evidence score across dwell, kinetics, curvature, and cycle morphology with explicit abstention (UNDETERMINED) when cues conflict.

scientific_purpose: Distinguish 1-4 sample technical vertical impulses from physiological contractions and localize plateau peaks
formula: w50_s <= 0.020s andw20_s <= 0.032s and sharp step ratio -> isolated_impulse_artefact; if on broad base -> localize on smoothed plateau
parameter_origin: Cardiomyocyte twitch duration cannot have FWHM <= 20 ms
validation_status: Physiologically grounded and validated on synthetic impulses
change_justification: Retain physical duration bounds in seconds (scaled by fs).

scientific_purpose: Accept contractions meeting SNR, relative amplitude, FWHM, and valley recovery criteria
formula: prom >= min_snr*sigma and amp >= min_rel_amplitude*A_ref and w50 >= min_width_s and valley_recovery >= min_rel_recovery
parameter_origin: Core v2 detector parameterized operating point
validation_status: Monotonic and user-configurable via strictness presets
change_justification: Retain and document in scientific_methods.md.

scientific_purpose: Reject narrow post-contraction relaxation bounces barely clearing threshold on incomplete recovery tail
formula: dt <= 0.36s and prev_amp >= 0.85*A_ref and amp < 1.15*thr and recovery < 0.72 and w50 < 0.62*med_w50
parameter_origin: Post-relaxation mechanical bounce morphology
validation_status: Tested on synthetic post-contraction bounce and real traces
change_justification: Document physical interpretation (incomplete relaxation + narrow width + borderline amplitude).

scientific_purpose: Layer 1 technical QC: check fs, signal length, finite fraction, valid duration, and overlap conflict rate
formula: fs >= 20 Hz, finite_frac >= 0.50, valid_dur >= 1.0s, conflict_frac <= 0.05
parameter_origin: Fundamental signal acquisition integrity constraints
validation_status: Validated by technical QC unit tests
change_justification: Retain Layer 1 technical checks.

scientific_purpose: Detect bidirectional tracking reversal where strong upward and downward excursions coexist
formula: n_up>=2 and n_dn>=2 and h_ratio>=0.30 and w_ratio>=0.40
parameters: min_peaks=2, min_h_ratio=0.30, min_w_ratio=0.40 (plus lines 107-121 narrow exclusion box)
parameter_origin: Lines 107-121 exclusion box (0.30<=h_ratio<=0.60 and 0.11<=med_wu<=0.20...) was tuned to spare specific segments
validation_status: Lines 107-121 contain narrow parameter-box carve-outs
change_justification: Replace narrow parameter-box carve-out with a general temporal/alternation check distinguishing true bidirectional tracking reversal from normal biphasic relaxation rebound following each beat.

scientific_purpose: Layer 2 interpretability QC: reject noise-dominated recordings while preserving clean quiescent and high-SNR traces
formula: 10+ disjunctive clauses combining sn_raw, sn_amp, drift_ratio, exc_ratio, med_acc_snr, acc_fraction, baseline_noise_rej
parameter_origin: Accumulated across multiple patches for SCRAMBLED ISO Seg 2/6 and NICONICO Seg 70/84
known_dataset_references: SCRAMBLED ISO Seg 2, Seg 6; NICONICO Seg 70, Seg 84
validation_status: Over-parameterized 10-clause boolean tree
change_justification: Consolidate into 3 transparent, interpretable quality metrics: (1) high-frequency noise floor when n_accepted==0, (2) waveform SNR & accepted-to-noise-rejection ratio when n_accepted>0, and (3) analyzable duration coverage.

scientific_purpose: Detect hardware fluorescence shutter dropouts and sudden downward step discontinuities
formula: sig < min_valid_value (0.05) or sudden step drop > 12*sigma_diff below 0.5*resting_med; dilate by 20 ms
parameter_origin: IonOptix photomultiplier / shutter dropout characteristics
validation_status: Physically grounded hardware artifact detector
change_justification: Retain hardware dropout masking.

scientific_purpose: Normalize ratiometric calcium trace to fractional change above resting baseline: Delta R / R0 = (R - R0) / R0
formula: norm = (sig_raw - baseline) / maximum(baseline, 1e-6); NaN on dropouts
parameter_origin: Standard ratiometric fluorescence normalization definition
validation_status: Standard mathematical definition; needs explicit invalid-baseline check when R0 <= 0.01
change_justification: Add explicit safeguard masking non-physical baselines (R0 <= 0.01) as NaN rather than dividing by 1e-6 and producing 10^5 spikes.

scientific_purpose: Minimum raw prominence threshold in standard and adult calcium detection
formula: Standard: prom >= (min_prominence_sigma * 0.43) * raw_noise_sigma; Adult: prom >= 2.85 * raw_noise_sigma
parameter_origin: 0.43 was introduced as an undocumented post-hoc multiplier on min_prominence_sigma=4.2 to yield 1.806
known_dataset_references: DISH1NICOTINE Seg 44 (comment in test explicitly cites 1.8 * raw_noise_sigma)
validation_status: Undocumented magic multiplier 0.43
change_justification: Replace hidden `* 0.43` factor with an explicit, documented parameter `raw_prominence_sigma` on CalciumDetectorParams so the true SD threshold (e.g. 1.8 in standard mode, 2.85 in adult mode) is directly visible and configurable.

scientific_purpose: Binary segment QC for ratiometric calcium recordings
formula: Check dropout_fraction > 0.50, analyzable_duration < 2.5s, baseline_instability, noise_sigma > max_noise_sigma_for_quiet
parameter_origin: Signal coverage and optical noise floor bounds; lines 978-981 have adult special-case branch
known_dataset_references: Comments cite SCRAMBLED ISO, ERROR-MOTION-CONTROLLER, IMR90 Seg 37, DISH1CONTROL Seg 4, DISH2ICI Seg 7, 8, CAR Seg 46
validation_status: Core coverage/noise rules are general; adult special branch (n_accepted<=2 and n_main==0) and dataset comments need cleanup
change_justification: Remove dataset-specific comments and unify low-SNR false-peak QC check across standard and adult modes.

scientific_purpose: Detect IonOptix FFT sarcomere length rail clipping near upper/lower optical bounds
parameter_origin: IonOptix FFT power-spectrum spatial frequency bounds (~1.12 to ~2.23 um)
validation_status: Hardcoded constants without configuration or signal-derived flatline check
change_justification: Expose rail_min_um and rail_max_um in a configurable SarcomereMeasurementProfile and combine with signal-derived flatline/clipping/step discontinuity detection so smooth extreme sarcomere lengths are not blindly flagged.

scientific_purpose: Detect non-physiological single-sample and narrow-cluster tracking velocity jumps
formula: abs_d1 > max(0.028, 7.5*sigma_hf); v_spike > max(0.024, 6.0*sigma_hf); bridge_max=7 samples;core_win=21 samples
units: um/sample and samples (implicitly assuming fs=250 Hz)
parameter_origin: Tuned at 250 Hz; comment on line 137 cites 'A Seg 1, A Seg 3, A Seg 16'
validation_status: Fails sampling-rate invariance because step thresholds are in um/sample and windows in samples
change_justification: Convert all derivative thresholds to physical velocity units (um/s divided by fs) and all window lengths to physical duration in seconds (s * fs).

scientific_purpose: Reject recordings dominated by FFT rail lock or tracking loss
formula: rail_frac > 0.035 or art_frac > 0.14 or max_art_dur_s > 0.80 or (rail_frac > 0.020 and n_clusters >= 10) or (art_frac > 0.08 and n_clusters >= 10 and med_row_corr < 0.70)
parameter_origin: Comment explicitly cites 'B Seg 7, B Seg 12, B Seg 32, B Seg 42'
known_dataset_references: ISO DISH1 Seg 7, Seg 12, Seg 32, Seg 42
validation_status: Multi-clause compound condition tuned to specific ISO segments
change_justification: Replace compound segment-tuned disjunction with clean, orthogonal coverage thresholds (max_rail_fraction, max_artifact_fraction, max_contiguous_artifact_s).

scientific_purpose: Reject any sarcomere recording with zero accepted contractions
formula: if n_accepted == 0: return 'REJECT', 'noise_dominated'
parameter_origin: Assumed all zero-event recordings in CAR/ISO were noise
validation_status: Violates physiological validity: a clean quiescent cardiomyocyte recording (low noise, stable baseline, no tracking failures) is falsely rejected as noise_dominated
change_justification: Distinguish clean quiescent recordings (n_accepted == 0, low sigma_hf, low artifact/rail fraction, stable baseline -> PASS 'clean_quiescent_no_contractions') from genuinely noise-dominated or tracking-artifact-dominated zero-event traces (REJECT).

scientific_purpose: Reject low-SNR noise traces where noise excursions mimic contractions
formula: 3 compound branches using asym, med_row_corr, dn_p98, med_snr, sigma_hf, n_noise_rej
parameters: asym<1.65, med_row_corr<0.75, dn_p98<0.045, med_snr<12.0, dn_p98<0.016, sigma_hf>0.0020
parameter_origin: Comments explicitly list 'A28, A29, A39, A41, B29, B39, B49, A4, A8, A10, A11, A21... Seg 9'
validation_status: Confirmed segment-list overfitting
change_justification: Replace segment-fitted 3-branch tree with a single general waveform-SNR and directional-asymmetry quality criterion.

scientific_purpose: Reject short recordings with many reconstructed intervals and rail touches
formula: if 0 < n_accepted <= 12 and n_rec_ivs >= 8 and (n_rec_ivs / n_accepted >= 0.75) and rail_frac >= 0.008: return 'REJECT', 'excessive_reconstruction_dependence'
parameter_origin: Specifically engineered to reject CAR DISH1 Seg 1 and Seg 3 (10 beats) while sparing longer recordings (>12 beats)
validation_status: Confirmed textbook example of dataset-specific overfitting (beat-count ceiling n_accepted <= 12)
change_justification: Remove the n_accepted <= 12 / n_rec_ivs >= 8 special rule entirely; evaluate reconstruction/corruption fraction uniformly across all recordings regardless of beat count.

scientific_purpose: Reject recordings where too many detected contractions are corrupted by tracking artifacts
formula: if corr_event_frac > 0.50 or (corr_event_frac >= 0.35 and n_clean < 3 and n_accepted < 8) or (n_clean == 0 and n_accepted < 6)
parameter_origin: General uncorrupted event majority requirement mixed with count-dependent clauses
validation_status: Count-dependent sub-clauses (<8, <6) are arbitrary
change_justification: Use a single count-invariant uncorrupted event fraction criterion: require that at least 50% of accepted contractions (and at least 1 event when n_accepted > 0) have uncorrupted, directly measured troughs.

scientific_purpose: Bridge narrow localized tracking spikes (<= 40 ms) using monotonic PCHIP interpolation for visualization and candidate timing
formula: Bridge clusters with duration <= max_reconstruct_ms (40 ms) and >= 2 intact anchor samples per side
parameter_origin: Signal-processing local interpolation bound (< half of a contraction twitch)
validation_status: Scientifically sound when raw data are preserved and trough amplitudes are not fabricated; has time-origin bug (missing t0 in interval timestamps)
change_justification: Pass t0 into reconstruct_narrow_tracking_artifacts so start_time_s and end_time_s include t0 and match artifact_intervals_s.

scientific_purpose: Prevent amplitude fabrication when contraction nadir falls inside an artifact; bound excursion from intact authentic shoulders
formula: If nadir in artifact: abs_shortening_um = NaN, pct_shortening = NaN; check intact shoulder samples within +-48 ms
parameter_origin: Conservative lower-bound verification from authentic uncorrupted samples
validation_status: Prevents amplitude fabrication; needs strict separation of n_directly_measured vs n_reconstructed_timings in pipeline
change_justification: Ensure events with NaN amplitude are flagged with has_valid_amplitude=False and never counted in n_directly_measured or amplitude means.

scientific_purpose: Flag contraction candidate as peak_corrupted if core window contains excessive artifact samples
formula: is_peak_corrupted = peak_in_art or (n_art_core > 14)
parameter_origin: Hardcoded sample count at 250 Hz
validation_status: Violates sampling-rate invariance
change_justification: Express threshold as physical duration (0.056 s * fs) rather than 14 samples.

scientific_purpose: First candidate validation pass (immediately overwritten on lines 504-506)
formula: Computes status/reason in lines 476-490, then overwrites with status='ACCEPTED', event_class='MAIN' in lines 504-506
parameter_origin: Accumulated dead code from iterative patching
validation_status: Confirmed dead/overwritten code block
change_justification: Remove dead overwritten lines 476-506 and perform candidate morphological validation + classification in one clean, single-pass authority.

scientific_purpose: Dual MAIN/SCE threshold computation and event classification (currently split across 3 conflicting passes)
formula: T_MAIN = clip(max(min_pct_main, noise_Floor, 0.35*P_ref), 0.35, 3.20); T_SCE = clip(max(min_pct_sce, 0.78*noise_Floor, 0.50*T_MAIN, 0.14*P_ref), 0.22, 1.65)
parameter_origin: Pass 1 uses pct+abs, Pass 2 uses timing (dt<=1.25s, pos>0) to reject SECONDARY, Pass 3 overwrites using pct only
validation_status: Three conflicting classification passes where Pass 3 overwrites Pass 2 and Pass 2 has dead variables
change_justification: Consolidate into a single authoritative classification function enforcing morphological validity (FWHM, prominence) and strict amplitude hierarchy (pct >= T_MAIN -> MAIN; T_SCE <= pct < T_MAIN -> SECONDARY; pct < T_SCE -> REJECTED), while recording descriptive timing context (incomplete relaxation, close coupling) as metadata without overriding the amplitude hierarchy.

scientific_purpose: Post-hoc 1-to-1 temporal matching between independently detected calcium transients and sarcomere contractions
formula: Search causal window [-0.04s, +0.28s] around calcium peak; estimate segment median EMD; assign HIGH/MODERATE/LOW match confidence
parameter_origin: Excitation-contraction coupling physiological latency
validation_status: Strictly post-hoc and read-only; verified to have zero influence on sarcomere or calcium detection
change_justification: Retain read-only post-hoc temporal matching; remove dead legacy assistance fields.
